theme: Light theme default with vibrant accents (E-commerce trust focus)

rules: Use text-5xl to text-6xl for main hero headings.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings.
Prices inside plan cards MUST be massive (text-5xl font-black) with the currency symbol and '/mes' smaller (text-lg text-muted-foreground).
Use uppercase wide-tracking labels (text-xs tracking-widest font-bold) for tags like 'PROMO PORTABILIDAD' or 'MÁS POPULAR'.

colors.background: bg-slate-50 for the page body to allow pure white plan cards to pop.
rules: DO NOT use generic gradients. Use flat vibrant colors.
Ensure text over primary blue is pure white for contrast.
Primary CTAs must be Orange to stand out from the Blue brand elements.

layouts.page_structure: Sticky Glassmorphism Header -> Hero Section with Category Tabs -> Plan Catalog Grid -> Coverage Checker -> Trust Features -> SEO Cities Marquee -> Footer
layouts.plan_cards: Use 3-column grid on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Cards must have pure white bg, 1px subtle border, and rounded-3xl. The 'Más Popular' card should have a blue border and an 'over-the-border' badge.
layouts.coverage_checker: Horizontal layout on desktop: Text on left, Input + Button on right. Dark blue background (#015EEF) with white text to break the visual rhythm. Must include success/error inline states.
layouts.checkout_wizard: Rendered as a multi-step modal (Dialog) or full-screen overlay when 'Contratar' is clicked. Must show a progress bar/stepper.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the top sticky navigation: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/50.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Use a subtle text marquee for the SEO cities (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia...) to pack keywords without looking like spam. It should look like an 'Editorial Ribbon'.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Plan cards should lift on hover (-translate-y-1) and shadow should increase. Tab switching must have a layout animation (Framer Motion).
visual_enhancers.badges: Use prominent icon badges (Lucide icons) with soft background tints for plan features.

accessibility: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tab-movil', data-testid='btn-contratar-plan1', data-testid='coverage-input').
Focus states must use ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2.
Contrast ratios must meet APCA/WCAG standards. Do not put light gray text on white.

images.description: Man using mobile phone (Use for Mobile Plans hero/banner)
Family watching TV on couch (Use for Fiber/TV Plans hero/banner)

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a full landing page simulating a public telecom store. Use a sophisticated tab system to switch between Móvil, Fibra, Satélite, and TV plans. Build out the checkout flow as a responsive multi-step modal/dialog. Ensure the SEO cities are visible but artfully integrated via a Marquee at the bottom. For the fiber checker, implement a simple stateful input that validates the address and shows 'Available' or 'Not Available' to demonstrate functionality. Remember to implement the brand colors explicitly (Blue #015EEF, Orange #FF7A00).
